issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the verb 'απολυσαι' (to put away/divorce) or its equivalent action. It says 'cho phép các ngươi để vợ mình' (allowed you to keep your wives), whereas the Greek says 'απολυσαι τας γυναικας υμων' (to put away/divorce your wives). This changes the meaning from a prohibition against divorce to a statement about keeping wives.
